extraction.Name: Emma Clairmont (Didier)
extraction.Recorded patent: Recorded April 9, 1920 by B. A. Olson
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: conveyed to Ben Dearinger on July 10, 1920 for $660.66
extraction.Buyer: Ben Dearinger for $660.66; deed of conveyance signed by James Didier
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739607 issued; northwest quarter of section 25, township 40, range 29; receipt for patent signed by James Didier, husband, April 3, 1920; Emma Clairmont died January 9, 1920 and the patent did not issue until March 1920; Rosebud, S. Dak.
